camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise BackFill --region cn-hangzhou --Asc false --HistoryDagId 16000 --BackFillDateBegin '2022-01-14' --IsTriggerSubTree true --FilterNodeIds '[12000]' --BackFillDateEnd '2022-09-29' --StartNodeIds '[2]' --BackFillDate '2022-01-14' --Tid 3000 --DagId 15000 --Interval 24
description_en: Backfills data for a task flow
description_zh: 调用BackFill接口，给任务编排补数据
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise back-fill --tid 3000 --dag-id 15000 --start-node-ids 2 --filter-node-ids 12000 --is-trigger-sub-tree true --back-fill-date 2022-01-14 --back-fill-date-begin 2022-01-14 --back-fill-date-end 2022-09-29 --interval 24 --asc false --history-dag-id 16000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BackFill

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The number of nodes for which you want to backfill data
parameters.help_zh:
补数据开始节点ID列表。

> 参数缺省时运行整个任务流
parameters.name: start_node_ids

parameters.help_en: Filter condition, which specifies the list of node IDs in the task flow that do not need to supplement data
parameters.help_zh: 过滤条件，指定任务流中无需补数据的节点Id列表
parameters.name: filter_node_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to run descendant nodes. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否运行下游节点。缺省时默认为true
parameters.name: is_trigger_sub_tree

parameters.help_en: The date for the data to be backfilled. This parameter is required if you specify a date for data backfill
parameters.help_zh: 补数据业务时间。指定时间补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date

parameters.help_en: The start date of the date range for the data to be backfilled. This parameter is required if you specify a date range for data backfill
parameters.help_zh: 补数据开始业务时间。指定时间范围补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date_begin

parameters.help_en: The end date of the date range for the data to be backfilled. This parameter is required if you specify a date range for data backfill
parameters.help_zh: 补数据结束业务时间。指定时间范围补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date_end

parameters.help_en: The interval at which data backfill is performed. Unit: hours. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 24
parameters.help_zh: 补数据时间间隔，单位：小时。最小值：1，默认值：24
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The running sequence of task flows for data backfill. Valid values:

*   **0**: reverse chronological order.
*   **1**: chronological order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
补数据任务流运行顺序。取值：
- **0**：降序。从大日期到小日期。
- **1**：默认值，升序。从小日期到大日期
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the historical task flow
parameters.help_zh:
历史任务流ID。

> 若您未填写该参数，在调用API时，系统会自动获取最近发布的任务流版本ID作为该参数的值。若没有发布过任务流，系统获取不到任务流版本ID，则调用会出错
parameters.name: history_dag_id
